Sandbox_HWE_EnableEvent_tooltip: Master switch for the Halloween event.
Sandbox_HWE_UseCalendarTrigger_tooltip: Automatically start and end the event on the configured in-game dates.
Sandbox_HWE_EnableDebugMenu_tooltip: Adds event testing controls under Debug > HWE in the context menu. Multiplayer server permissions still apply.
Sandbox_HWE_StartSchedule_tooltip: In-game start date and time. Use MM/DD HH:MM, for example 10/15 00:00.
Sandbox_HWE_EndSchedule_tooltip: In-game end date and time. Use MM/DD HH:MM, for example 10/31 23:59.
Sandbox_HWE_CostumeChancePercent_tooltip: Chance for an eligible loaded zombie to receive a costume when the event activates. Reroll ignores this chance. Range: 0–100.
Sandbox_HWE_NaturalSpawnTotalWeight_tool: Relative weight shared by all natural Halloween outfits. Sports share one pool. Set to 0 to disable these natural spawns.
Sandbox_HWE_CandyDropChancePercent_toolt: Chance for loose candy on a costumed zombie. Rolls independently of treat containers and event items. Range: 0–100.
Sandbox_HWE_BagChancePercent_tooltip: Chance for a treat container on a costumed zombie. Rolls independently of loose candy and event items. Range: 0–100.
Sandbox_HWE_CollectibleContainerChancePe: Within the treat-container roll, chance to use an enabled Cat Pail, Ghost Bucket or Witch Cauldron instead of a vanilla bag. Range: 0–100.
Sandbox_HWE_BagCandyChancePercent_toolti: Chance for a dropped treat container to contain candy. Range: 0–100.
Sandbox_HWE_MinBagCandy_tooltip: Minimum candy pieces added to a dropped treat container. Range: 1–5.
Sandbox_HWE_MaxBagCandy_tooltip: Maximum candy pieces added to a dropped treat container. Range: 1–5.
Sandbox_HWE_DecorationChanceOnZombiePerc: Chance for one enabled event reward on a costumed zombie, separate from candy. Default: 2 percent. Carry buckets use their separate treat-container roll.
Sandbox_HWE_CostumeBlacklist_tooltip: Choose opens a searchable costume and item picker. Disabled entries leave future event and loot rolls; existing items stay. Debug spawns remain available. Save the Sandbox Options window to apply. Legacy All disables costumes only; Items disables every reward.
Sandbox_HWE_WorldDecorationChancePercent: Chance for one enabled reward when eligible wardrobe, household or garage storage first fills during the event. Default: 3 percent. Excludes shops, vehicle trunks, carried bags, corpses and player-built crates.
Sandbox_HWE_MaxDecorationsPerContainer: Maximum event items per storage container
Sandbox_HWE_MaxDecorationsPerContainer_t: Maximum event rewards in eligible world storage. Default: 1; 0 disables storage rewards. Each fill rolls for at most one new item.
